# NIM lab dependencies. The lab itself runs on the Python standard library;
# these add optional features. Install with: ./start.sh install
#
# NVCF gRPC transport (v3.5) for models build.nvidia.com serves only over
# gRPC (grpc.nvcf.nvidia.com:443): Riva ASR (Canary, Parakeet, Conformer,
# Whisper), TTS (Magpie zero-shot, Chatterbox) and translation. Pulls in
# grpcio and protobuf. On Termux, `pkg install python-grpcio` first so pip
# does not have to compile grpcio (./start.sh install does this).
nvidia-riva-client>=2.19
